title: 11th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/11/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of three previous sittings (minutes Nos. 5/3/2025 to 7/3/2025).

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, Mohamed Ameen: why has the helicopter service promised for last March not started, when is it now expected to begin, and does the company contracted still intend to provide it?

Question from Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim to the Minister of Transport and Civil Aviation, Mohamed Ameen: with frequent serious accidents in Malé costing lives and no major change to roads or traffic flow, what is the Transport Ministry currently prioritising to reduce accidents?

From the Speaker's desk: the matter of appointing a member of Parliament to the Judicial Service Commission, under Article 158(b) of the Constitution and Article 3(5) of Law No. 10/2008 (Judicial Service Commission Act).

Report of the Independent Institutions Committee on its review of the appointment of the President of the Maldives Media and Broadcasting Commission under Article 22(a) of Law No. 16/2025 (Maldives Media and Broadcasting Regulation Act).
Report of the National Security Services Committee on matters it reviewed concerning the Maldives Customs Service.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to question the Transport Minister on the delayed helicopter service and Malé road safety, pick a Parliament member for the Judicial Service Commission, and consider committee reports on the media commission's president and Customs.
